value.title: http - always 301 Moved Permanently - Stack Overflow
value.snippet: But as you can see, address i am trying to connect and in location header are the same. When i try to do it with other sites (for example github .com, www.youtube.com, www.twitch.tv), i get the same thing - 301 Moved Permanently but the address in location header and mine are the same. value.title: 301 Moved Permanently - HTTP | MDN - MDN Web Docs
value.snippet: The HTTP 301 Moved Permanently redirection response status code indicates that the requested resource has been permanently moved to the URL in the Location header.
